description: 6 AI agent skills (SKILL.md) for French bureaucracy: Comptable (accounting, TVA, IS, closing, FEC, liasse fiscale), Notaire (real estate, succession, donation), Fiscaliste (IR, IFI, PFU, LMNP, RSU, crypto), Syndic (copropriété management), Commissaire-aux-Comptes (audit, NEP), Contrôleur Fiscal (tax audit simulation). Includes Node.js helper scripts for FEC, PDFs, financial statements, and Qonto/Stripe integrations.
